program: Agua Potable Rural / Servicios Sanitarios Rurales (APR/SSR) — inversión
provider: Dirección de Obras Hidráulicas (DOH) — Subdirección de Servicios Sanitarios Rurales
eligible_actor: comités y cooperativas de agua potable rural (community_org); municipality facilitates/co-formulates
amount_note: Program-level, not per-project: ~half of DOH budget, order CLP 300 bn/yr; sector estimated need ~US$500M. New systems, expansion, and sanitation for rural localities. Per-project amounts via SNI/BIP formulation.
notes: Climate-explicit: rural water security & sanitation (adaptation). Program since 1964; ~2,422 systems; ~2.27M people. Statutory basis Ley 20.998 (Servicios Sanitarios Rurales). Beneficiary = rural water committee/cooperative, NOT the municipality directly. Five-year modernization co-financed by a World Bank US$250M loan (Water Transition Program). RECURRENCE=permanent standing/statutory.

eligible_actor: comités y cooperativas de agua potable rural (community_org)
amount_note: Conservation/maintenance of existing APR infrastructure; per the DOH conservation budget line.
notes: Maintenance counterpart of APR/SSR investment; explicit water-security relevance. Permanent standing line. Confirm exact budget against DIPRES/MOP execution reports.

program: Fondo para la Investigación, Innovación y Educación en Recursos Hídricos (FIIE)
eligible_actor: personas jurídicas (incl. municipios, universidades, organizaciones de usuarios de agua)
amount_note: Competitive fund (concurso DGA); ~CLP 166.8M in the 2026 (3rd) edition; regional distribution.
notes: Recurring competitive fund created by the Ley 21.435 (2022) Código de Aguas reform; funds research/innovation/education on water resources incl. Planes Estratégicos de Recursos Hídricos en Cuencas (PERHC). Legal entities eligible incl. municipios; jury seats municipal associations. 3rd edition 2026. REVIEW: replaced a prior generic 'Gestión de cuencas / aplicación Código de Aguas' entry that was statutory framework, not a fund.

program: Programa Infraestructura para el Buen Vivir (PIBV)
eligible_actor: comunidades y territorios rurales/indígenas; otros ejecutores (public_agency, municipal) por convenio
amount_note: Annual budget program (Partida 12, Capítulo 02, Programa 14). Funds indigenous road conservation, basic roads, rural sanitation, rural buildings; feasibility/design for 15,000+ homes and 1,000+ new rural water systems. Amounts in DIPRES/DGOP quarterly execution reports.
notes: GEOGRAPHICALLY GATED: Arauco, Biobío, Malleco, Cautín; from 2024 also Los Ríos & Los Lagos. Do not surface for comunas outside these. Cross-sector rural infra; climate-adjacent. RECURRENCE=time-boxed (annual budget but targeted program horizon), flag as not-permanent.

program: Fondo de Infraestructura para el Desarrollo
eligible_actor: otros ejecutores (public_agency, municipal, regional) por convenio
amount_note: Development-infrastructure transfer fund (Subt 33 'A otros ejecutores'); amounts per Ley de Presupuestos / DIPRES.
notes: Cross-sector infrastructure transfer fund; climate-adjacent. Budget-line dependent -> flag as time-boxed. Confirm scope/amounts against DGOP/DIPRES at build of any city row.

program: Plan de Infraestructura en Asociación Público-Privada 2022-2026 (Concesiones)
provider: Dirección General de Concesiones de Obras Públicas (DGC)
amount_note: Multi-year APP/concession pipeline 2022-2026 (roads, airports, hospitals, energy-supply works); financed via concession model, not a grant.
notes: Named 2022-2026 plan with an end date -> RECURRENCE=time-boxed. PPP instrument; city is not the applicant. Climate-adjacent.

program: Dirección de Arquitectura — Iniciativas de Inversión / Equipamiento social y comunitario
amount_note: Subt 31 Iniciativas de Inversión for public/community buildings; per SNI/BIP formulation and Ley de Presupuestos.
notes: Public-building investment; climate relevance indirect (energy in public buildings). Standing investment subtitle. Flows through the SNI/BIP gate, not a concurso. REVIEW: not a discrete fundable opportunity (no application window) — candidate to drop.
